# 🧰 Project Templates

Use these templates to keep project work consistent and reviewable. Remove instructional prompts only after completing the relevant sections.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Bug investigation](bug-investigation.md) | Capture reproduction, evidence, and root cause |
| [Feature proposal](feature-proposal.md) | Define user problem, scope, risks, and acceptance criteria |
| [UI/accessibility review](ui-accessibility-review.md) | Review visual and assistive-technology behavior |
| [Food-safety review](food-safety-review.md) | Review listing, allergen, and handoff implications |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Record release validation |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Define scenarios and results |
| [Incident report](incident-report.md) | Document an operational or safety incident |

Templates do not replace engineering review, qualified food-safety guidance, privacy review, or legal advice.
